dct_description_sm: The OMI Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2) tropospheric parameter displays the tropospheric component of the total NO2 column measured in molecules/cm².

The Ozone Monitoring Instrument (OMI) Level-3 NO2 (OMNO2d) product provides daily gridded global coverage with a temporal resolution of 1 day, imagery resolution of 2 km and sensor/algorithm resolution where pixel level data of good quality are binned and "averaged" into 0.25 x 0.25 degree global grids.

A daily visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), available from 2004-10-01 and updated as new data arrive. Made from OMI/Aura NO2 Cloud-Screened Total and Tropospheric Column L3 Global Gridded 0.25 degree x 0.25 degree V004 (OMNO2d) (OMNO2d, version 004, doi:10.5067/Aura/OMI/DATA3407).
